mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, the combination signals aggressive tightening and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, the combination signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% in a month during a late-cycle expansion and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
